summary: Tested 4 new admin features (SMS alerts, gateway health monitoring + cron, audit log, Abena tickets UI) backend + frontend, plus light regression. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (tests/test_iteration14_admin_ops.py). Frontend: all 8 sidebar pages load with no page errors; Tickets filter/detail/chat/mark-resolved/reopen/reply flow works; Monitoring check-now updates gateway cards; Activity filters, search, details (secrets shown ***) work; SMS settings tab validation toast + number normalization work; public site loads. SMS with fake creds fails gracefully (Hubtel 400 'Provided ClientId could not be found') and is logged; application creation stays fast (0.5s) and logs new_submission sms entry. Cleanup done: SMS settings disabled/empty, test app deleted, test-ticket-1 back to status open.

minor.issue: Returns emailed:true (and UI toast 'Reply sent by email') based only on presence of customer_email, even when email_svc.send fails (Resend rejected test@example.com; email_log has error). Should reflect actual send result.

Empty client_secret always means 'keep stored', so admin can never clear the stored SMS secret via API/UI (tester had to clear in Mongo). Consider an explicit clear flag or clear when client_id is emptied.
error stored as str(python dict) ("{'rate': 0.0, ... 'statusDescription': ...}"); UI shows raw dict. Prefer statusDescription.
Hubtel 'up' check is GET on payproxyapi host returning HTTP 404 (any <500 = up). Only checks reachability, not API health; acceptable but weak.
IP taken from first X-Forwarded-For value (client-spoofable). Minor.

ui_bugs.issue: No try/catch around status POST — failure gives unhandled promise rejection and no error toast
onSubmit calls setPage(1) then load() with stale page; if on page>1 it fetches the old page then refetches. Minor.

action_items: Make ticket reply 'emailed' reflect actual email send success (return send result/error)
Store/display Hubtel statusDescription instead of raw dict in sms_log error
Add try/catch + error toast in AdminTickets setStatus
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2770+ lines — should be split into routers (tickets, sms, health, audit).
cron endpoint correctly acks immediately and dedupes via unique index on cron_runs.run_id (verified).
Audit redaction regex (pass|secret|key|token) works for login password and sms client_secret; empty values not masked (fine).
seed_data_creation: None. Created+deleted test app GH-2026-118047; test-ticket-1 now has admin_reply 'TEST_UI reply from admin' set (status restored to open). Test cron_runs/gateway_health/audit/sms_log entries remain (logs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist). test-ticket-1 customer_email is test@example.com which Resend rejects, so support_reply email_log entries contain an error. SMS settings restored to disabled/empty (secret cleared directly in Mongo since API keeps empty secret).
